id-20261026-news-2.title: Coal Downstreaming into Methanol in East Kalimantan: Import Substitution Opportunities and Risks to Consider

segments.src: Rencana pembangunan pabrik hilirisasi batu bara menjadi metanol di Kalimantan Timur kembali menarik perhatian publik.
segments.tr: Plans for the construction of a coal downstreaming plant into methanol in East Kalimantan have once again attracted public attention.

segments.src: Proyek semacam ini dipandang sebagai langkah untuk mengolah sumber daya dalam negeri menjadi produk bernilai tambah.
segments.tr: Projects of this nature are seen as a step to process domestic resources into value-added products.

segments.src: Namun, seperti proyek industri berskala besar lainnya, ada manfaat yang menjanjikan sekaligus pertanyaan yang layak diajukan secara terbuka.
segments.tr: However, like other large-scale industrial projects, there are promising benefits alongside questions that deserve to be openly raised.

segments.src: > Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat investasi. Angka dan jadwal proyek dapat berubah, jadi pembaca disarankan merujuk pada pernyataan resmi pemerintah dan pelaksana proyek.
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for general information and is not investment advice. Figures and project schedules may change, so readers are advised to refer to official statements from the government and project implementers.

segments.src: ## Apa itu hilirisasi batu bara menjadi metanol?
segments.tr: ## What is coal downstreaming into methanol?

segments.src: Hilirisasi berarti mengolah bahan mentah di dalam negeri sehingga tidak dijual dalam bentuk asalnya saja.
segments.tr: Downstreaming means processing raw materials domestically so they are not sold just in their original form.

segments.src: Dalam kasus ini, batu bara diubah melalui proses gasifikasi menjadi gas sintesis, lalu diolah menjadi metanol.
segments.tr: In this case, coal is converted through a gasification process into synthesis gas, and then processed into methanol.

segments.src: Metanol adalah bahan kimia dasar yang dipakai pada banyak industri, misalnya:
segments.tr: Methanol is a basic chemical used in many industries, for example:

segments.src: - pembuatan formaldehida untuk lem dan resin pada industri kayu lapis dan furnitur;
segments.tr: - the manufacture of formaldehyde for glues and resins in the plywood and furniture industries;

segments.src: - bahan baku berbagai produk kimia dan plastik;
segments.tr: - raw materials for various chemical and plastic products;

segments.src: - bahan campuran dalam beberapa jenis bahan bakar dan pelarut.
segments.tr: - blending components in certain types of fuels and solvents.

segments.src: ## Manfaat yang diharapkan
segments.tr: ## Expected Benefits

segments.src: Nilai tambah ekonomi.** Produk olahan umumnya memiliki nilai jual lebih tinggi daripada batu bara mentah.
segments.tr: Economic added value.** Processed products generally have a higher selling price than raw coal.

segments.src: Selisih nilai ini berpotensi tinggal di dalam negeri, termasuk melalui pajak, royalti, dan belanja lokal.
segments.tr: This value differential has the potential to remain within the country, including through taxes, royalties, and local spending.

segments.src: Substitusi impor.** Indonesia selama ini masih mengimpor sebagian kebutuhan metanol untuk industri.
segments.tr: Import substitution.** Indonesia has so far still imported a portion of its industrial methanol needs.

segments.src: Jika produksi domestik mampu memenuhi sebagian kebutuhan tersebut, ketergantungan pada pasokan luar negeri dan tekanan pada devisa dapat berkurang.
segments.tr: If domestic production can meet some of these needs, reliance on foreign supplies and pressure on foreign exchange can be reduced.

segments.src: Lapangan kerja dan industri pendukung.** Pembangunan dan pengoperasian pabrik dapat membuka pekerjaan, baik langsung maupun di sektor jasa, logistik, dan konstruksi di sekitar lokasi.
segments.tr: Employment and supporting industries.** The construction and operation of the plant can open up jobs, both directly and in the service, logistics, and construction sectors around the location.

segments.src: Diversifikasi penggunaan batu bara.** Di tengah ketidakpastian permintaan batu bara sebagai bahan bakar pembangkit listrik, pemanfaatan sebagai bahan baku kimia dapat menjadi salah satu jalur tambahan.
segments.tr: Diversification of coal use.** Amid uncertainty in coal demand as a power plant fuel, utilization as a chemical feedstock can serve as an additional pathway.

segments.src: ## Pertanyaan yang layak diawasi publik
segments.tr: ## Questions Worth Public Scrutiny

segments.src: **Biaya dan kelayakan keuangan.** Pabrik gasifikasi membutuhkan investasi besar.
segments.tr: **Cost and financial feasibility.** Gasification plants require massive investment.

segments.src: Publik perlu tahu siapa yang menanggung biaya, bagaimana skema pembiayaannya, dan apakah ada insentif fiskal atau jaminan pembelian.
segments.tr: The public needs to know who bears the costs, what the financing scheme is, and whether there are fiscal incentives or purchase guarantees.

segments.src: Harga metanol dunia berfluktuasi, sehingga proyeksi keuntungan perlu diuji terhadap berbagai skenario.
segments.tr: Global methanol prices fluctuate, so profit projections need to be tested against various scenarios.

segments.src: **Emisi dan lingkungan.** Gasifikasi batu bara pada umumnya menghasilkan emisi karbon dioksida yang signifikan.
segments.tr: **Emissions and the environment.** Coal gasification generally produces significant carbon dioxide emissions.

segments.src: Pertanyaan pentingnya: apakah ada rencana penangkapan karbon, bagaimana pengelolaan air dan limbah, dan bagaimana hasil kajian dampak lingkungan dibuka kepada masyarakat.
segments.tr: The important questions are whether there is a carbon capture plan, how water and waste are managed, and how the environmental impact assessment results are disclosed to the public.

segments.src: Klaim lingkungan sebaiknya disertai data yang dapat diverifikasi.
segments.tr: Environmental claims should be accompanied by verifiable data.

segments.src: **Kesiapan pasar.** Substitusi impor hanya berhasil bila ada pembeli.
segments.tr: **Market readiness.** Import substitution only succeeds if there are buyers.

segments.src: Perlu kejelasan apakah industri hilir di dalam negeri siap menyerap metanol, apakah harganya kompetitif dengan produk impor, dan apakah kualitasnya memenuhi standar pengguna.
segments.tr: Clarity is needed on whether domestic downstream industries are ready to absorb methanol, whether the prices are competitive with imported products, and whether the quality meets user standards.

segments.src: **Pasokan batu bara dan energi.** Pabrik membutuhkan pasokan batu bara yang stabil dengan spesifikasi tertentu, serta listrik dan air dalam jumlah besar.
segments.tr: **Coal and energy supply.** The plant requires a stable coal supply with specific specifications, as well as large amounts of electricity and water.

segments.src: Pengaturan ini perlu dipastikan tidak mengganggu kebutuhan lain di daerah.
segments.tr: These arrangements need to be ensured not to disrupt other needs in the region.

segments.src: **Dampak bagi masyarakat sekitar.** Warga di sekitar lokasi berhak mendapat informasi tentang pembebasan lahan, kualitas udara dan air, serta peluang kerja bagi tenaga lokal.
segments.tr: **Impact on the surrounding community.** Residents around the location are entitled to information about land acquisition, air and water quality, and job opportunities for local workers.

segments.src: ## Menimbang secara seimbang
segments.tr: ## A Balanced Weighing

segments.src: Hilirisasi bukan solusi tunggal.
segments.tr: Downstreaming is not a silver bullet.

segments.src: Nilai tambah dan pengurangan impor adalah tujuan yang masuk akal, tetapi keberhasilannya bergantung pada kelayakan ekonomi, tata kelola yang transparan, dan pengelolaan dampak lingkungan yang kredibel.
segments.tr: Added value and import reduction are sensible goals, but their success depends on economic feasibility, transparent governance, and credible environmental impact management.

segments.src: Kajian independen, laporan berkala, dan keterbukaan data akan membantu publik menilai apakah proyek ini benar-benar memberi manfaat jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Independent reviews, periodic reports, and data transparency will help the public assess whether this project truly delivers long-term benefits.

segments.src: ## Hal yang bisa dipantau pembaca
segments.tr: ## Things Readers Can Monitor

segments.src: - dokumen analisis dampak lingkungan dan pembaruan izin proyek;
segments.tr: - environmental impact analysis documents and project permit updates;

segments.src: - kejelasan skema pembiayaan dan insentif;
segments.tr: - clarity of financing schemes and incentives;

segments.src: - kontrak atau komitmen pembelian dari industri pengguna metanol;
segments.tr: - contracts or purchase commitments from methanol-using industries;

segments.src: - laporan emisi dan rencana mitigasi setelah pabrik beroperasi.
segments.tr: - emission reports and mitigation plans after the plant is operational.

segments.src: Dengan pengawasan yang konstruktif, proyek hilirisasi dapat dinilai berdasarkan fakta, bukan sekadar janji.
segments.tr: With constructive oversight, downstreaming projects can be evaluated based on facts, not just promises.

segments.src: Itulah cara terbaik agar kebijakan industri benar-benar berpihak pada kepentingan publik.
segments.tr: That is the best way to ensure industrial policies truly side with the public interest.

id-20261026-news-3.title: Changes in the Coordinating Ministry for Political and Security Affairs: Ministerial Duties and Indicators to Assess Security Coordination Performance

segments.src: Pergantian pucuk pimpinan Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Politik dan Keamanan (Kemenko Polkam), dari Djamari Chaniago ke Dudung Abdurachman, kembali menempatkan isu koordinasi keamanan, penegakan hukum, dan pembenahan Polri dalam sorotan.
segments.tr: The leadership change in the Coordinating Ministry for Political and Security Affairs (Kemenko Polkam), from Djamari Chaniago to Dudung Abdurachman, has once again brought the issues of security coordination, law enforcement, and the reform of the Indonesian National Police (Polri) into the spotlight.

segments.src: Artikel ini tidak menilai pribadi siapa pun.
segments.tr: This article does not evaluate any individuals.

segments.src: Tujuannya membantu pembaca memahami apa yang sebenarnya menjadi tugas kementerian koordinator ini, dan indikator apa yang dapat dipakai publik untuk menilai kinerjanya secara adil.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to help readers understand what the duties of this coordinating ministry truly are, and what indicators the public can use to fairly assess its performance.

segments.src: > Catatan: Informasi mengenai susunan kabinet dapat berubah. Untuk data terbaru, rujuklah pengumuman resmi pemerintah dan situs resmi kementerian terkait.
segments.tr: > Note: Information regarding the cabinet composition is subject to change. For the latest data, refer to official government announcements and the official websites of the relevant ministries.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu Menko Polkam?
segments.tr: ## What is the Coordinating Minister for Political and Security Affairs?

segments.src: Menteri Koordinator (Menko) bukan atasan langsung bagi aparat di lapangan.
segments.tr: A Coordinating Minister (Menko) is not a direct supervisor to field personnel.

segments.src: Perannya adalah **menyinkronkan dan mengoordinasikan** kebijakan antarkementerian dan lembaga.
segments.tr: Their role is to **synchronize and coordinate** policies between ministries and agencies.

segments.src: Kemenko Polkam mengoordinasikan sejumlah bidang, antara lain:
segments.tr: The Coordinating Ministry for Political and Security Affairs coordinates several areas, including:

segments.src: - **Politik dalam negeri dan hubungan luar negeri**, termasuk stabilitas politik dan kerja sama internasional.
segments.tr: - **Domestic politics and foreign relations**, including political stability and international cooperation.

segments.src: - **Pertahanan dan keamanan**, yang melibatkan Kementerian Pertahanan, TNI, dan Polri.
segments.tr: - **Defense and security**, which involves the Ministry of Defense, the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI), and Polri.

segments.src: - **Hukum dan hak asasi manusia**, yang berkaitan dengan Kementerian Hukum, Kementerian HAM, Kejaksaan, dan lembaga penegak hukum lainnya.
segments.tr: - **Law and human rights**, which pertains to the Ministry of Law, the Ministry of Human Rights, the Attorney General's Office, and other law enforcement agencies.

segments.src: - **Penanganan isu lintas sektor**, seperti keamanan siber, terorisme, narkotika, perbatasan, dan keamanan maritim.
segments.tr: - **Cross-sector issue handling**, such as cybersecurity, terrorism, narcotics, border security, and maritime security.

segments.src: Karena sifatnya koordinatif, keberhasilan Menko Polkam sering kali tidak tampak sebagai "hasil sendiri".
segments.tr: Due to its coordinative nature, the success of the Coordinating Minister for Political and Security Affairs often does not appear as a "stand-alone result".

segments.src: Ukurannya adalah apakah instansi-instansi di bawah koordinasinya bergerak selaras dan tidak saling tumpang tindih.
segments.tr: The measure of success is whether the agencies under their coordination move in harmony and do not overlap with one another.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Pergantian Ini Menarik Perhatian?
segments.tr: ## Why Has This Leadership Change Attracted Attention?

segments.src: Ada beberapa alasan mengapa pergantian di pos ini mudah menjadi perhatian publik:
segments.tr: There are several reasons why changes in this post easily draw public attention:

segments.src: 1. **Isu keamanan menyentuh kehidupan sehari-hari.** Mulai dari ketertiban umum, aksi unjuk rasa, hingga kejahatan siber, semuanya berkaitan dengan rasa aman warga.
segments.tr: 1. **Security issues touch everyday life.** Ranging from public order and demonstrations to cybercrime, everything is related to citizens' sense of security.

segments.src: 2. **Penegakan hukum menuntut kepercayaan.** Survei dan diskusi publik berulang kali menunjukkan bahwa kepercayaan terhadap proses hukum sangat memengaruhi legitimasi pemerintah.
segments.tr: 2. **Law enforcement demands trust.** Surveys and public discussions have repeatedly shown that trust in the legal process greatly influences government legitimacy.

segments.src: 3. **Pembenahan Polri menjadi agenda besar.** Wacana reformasi kepolisian menyangkut profesionalisme, akuntabilitas, pengawasan internal dan eksternal, serta kedekatan dengan masyarakat.
segments.tr: 3. **The reform of Polri is a major agenda.** Discussions on police reform involve professionalism, accountability, internal and external oversight, and closeness to the community.

segments.src: 4. **Latar belakang pejabat sering diperdebatkan.** Sebagian kalangan mencermati latar belakang militer atau kepolisian seorang menteri. Namun penilaian yang sehat sebaiknya bertumpu pada kebijakan dan hasil kerja, bukan pada asumsi.
segments.tr: 4. **Officials' backgrounds are frequently debated.** Some circles scrutinize a minister's military or police background. However, a sound assessment should be based on policies and work results, not assumptions.

segments.src: ## Tantangan Koordinasi yang Dihadapi
segments.tr: ## Coordination Challenges Faced

segments.src: Siapa pun yang memimpin Kemenko Polkam akan berhadapan dengan tantangan yang kurang lebih serupa:
segments.tr: Whoever leads the Coordinating Ministry for Political and Security Affairs will face largely similar challenges:

segments.src: - **Ego sektoral.** Setiap lembaga memiliki mandat, anggaran, dan budaya kerja sendiri. Koordinasi sering terhambat bila tidak ada mekanisme yang jelas.
segments.tr: - **Sectoral ego.** Each institution has its own mandate, budget, and work culture. Coordination is often hampered if there is no clear mechanism.

segments.src: - **Batas kewenangan yang tipis.** Menko tidak memerintah langsung Kapolri, Panglima TNI, atau Jaksa Agung. Pengaruhnya bergantung pada dukungan Presiden dan kualitas komunikasi.
segments.tr: - **Thin boundaries of authority.** The Coordinating Minister does not directly command the Chief of Police, the Commander of the TNI, or the Attorney General. Their influence depends on the President's support and communication quality.

segments.src: - **Keseimbangan antara keamanan dan kebebasan sipil.** Kebijakan keamanan yang efektif tetap harus menghormati hak warga untuk berpendapat dan berkumpul.
segments.tr: - **The balance between security and civil liberties.** Effective security policies must still respect citizens' rights to express opinions and assemble.

segments.src: - **Ancaman yang terus berubah.** Kejahatan siber, penyebaran disinformasi, dan kejahatan terorganisasi lintas negara menuntut pembaruan strategi secara berkala.
segments.tr: - **Constantly changing threats.** Cybercrime, the spread of disinformation, and transnational organized crime require periodic updates to strategies.

segments.src: ## Indikator yang Dapat Dipakai Publik untuk Menilai Kinerja
segments.tr: ## Indicators the Public Can Use to Assess Performance

segments.src: Agar penilaian tidak sekadar berdasarkan kesan, berikut beberapa indikator yang dapat dipantau secara terbuka.
segments.tr: So that assessments are not merely based on impressions, here are several indicators that can be openly monitored.

segments.src: ### 1. Kepastian dan Kepercayaan Hukum
segments.tr: ### 1. Legal Certainty and Trust

segments.src: - Tingkat kepercayaan publik terhadap kepolisian, kejaksaan, dan pengadilan dalam survei independen.
segments.tr: - The level of public trust in the police, the prosecution, and the courts in independent surveys.

segments.src: - Kecepatan dan transparansi penanganan perkara yang menjadi perhatian publik.
segments.tr: - The speed and transparency of handling cases of public concern.

segments.src: - Jumlah dan tindak lanjut pengaduan masyarakat terhadap aparat.
segments.tr: - The number and follow-up of public complaints against officials.

segments.src: ### 2. Pembenahan Polri
segments.tr: ### 2. Reform of Polri

segments.src: - Kejelasan peta jalan pembenahan, termasuk target dan jangka waktunya.
segments.tr: - The clarity of the reform roadmap, including targets and timeframes.

segments.src: - Penguatan pengawasan, misalnya kinerja Kompolnas dan mekanisme etik internal.
segments.tr: - The strengthening of oversight, such as the performance of the National Police Commission (Kompolnas) and internal ethical mechanisms.

segments.src: - Hasil penindakan terhadap pelanggaran disiplin dan etik, yang diumumkan secara terbuka.
segments.tr: - The results of actions taken against disciplinary and ethical violations, announced openly.

segments.src: ### 3. Koordinasi Antarlembaga
segments.tr: ### 3. Inter-Agency Coordination

segments.src: - Ada tidaknya forum koordinasi rutin dan keputusan bersama yang dapat ditelusuri.
segments.tr: - The presence or absence of routine coordination forums and traceable joint decisions.

segments.src: - Kecepatan respons terhadap krisis, seperti bencana, kerusuhan, atau gangguan keamanan siber.
segments.tr: - Response speed to crises, such as disasters, riots, or cybersecurity disruptions.

segments.src: - Berkurangnya tumpang tindih program antarinstansi.
segments.tr: - The reduction of overlapping programs between institutions.

segments.src: ### 4. Rasa Aman dan Ketertiban
segments.tr: ### 4. Sense of Security and Order

segments.src: - Tren data kriminalitas dari sumber resmi, dibaca bersama konteks pelaporan.
segments.tr: - Crime data trends from official sources, read along with reporting contexts.

segments.src: - Penanganan aksi unjuk rasa yang menghormati hak warga dan menjaga ketertiban.
segments.tr: - The handling of demonstrations that respects citizens' rights and maintains order.

segments.src: - Kemajuan pemberantasan narkotika, perdagangan orang, dan kejahatan siber.
segments.tr: - Progress in eradicating narcotics, human trafficking, and cybercrime.

segments.src: ### 5. Keterbukaan dan Akuntabilitas
segments.tr: ### 5. Openness and Accountability

segments.src: - Frekuensi penjelasan publik dan keterbukaan data.
segments.tr: - The frequency of public explanations and data openness.

segments.src: - Kesediaan menerima masukan dari akademisi, organisasi masyarakat sipil, dan media.
segments.tr: - The willingness to receive input from academics, civil society organizations, and the media.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Berita Secara Kritis
segments.tr: ## How to Read the News Critically

segments.src: Dalam isu politik dan keamanan, informasi mudah bercampur dengan opini.
segments.tr: In political and security issues, information easily mixes with opinion.

segments.src: Beberapa kebiasaan berikut dapat membantu:
segments.tr: The following habits can help:

segments.src: - **Periksa sumber.** Utamakan pernyataan resmi, dokumen publik, dan media yang memiliki standar redaksi jelas.
segments.tr: - **Check sources.** Prioritize official statements, public documents, and media with clear editorial standards.

segments.src: - **Bedakan fakta dan opini.** Pernyataan "akan" atau "berencana" belum sama dengan hasil.
segments.tr: - **Differentiate facts from opinions.** Statements such as "will" or "plan to" are not yet the same as results.

segments.src: - **Lihat jangka waktu.** Kinerja kementerian koordinator lebih tepat dinilai dalam hitungan bulan hingga tahun, bukan dari satu peristiwa.
segments.tr: - **Look at the time frame.** A coordinating ministry's performance is better assessed over months to years, rather than from a single event.

segments.src: - **Cari data pembanding.** Satu angka tanpa pembanding mudah menyesatkan.
segments.tr: - **Look for comparative data.** A single figure without a comparison can easily mislead.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Pergantian Menko Polkam adalah momentum bagi publik untuk menengok kembali peran kementerian yang sering terdengar namun jarang dipahami.
segments.tr: The change in the Coordinating Minister for Political and Security Affairs is a momentum for the public to revisit the role of a ministry that is often heard of but rarely understood.

segments.src: Koordinasi yang baik tidak selalu terlihat mencolok.
segments.tr: Good coordination is not always conspicuous.

segments.src: Hasilnya tampak pada penegakan hukum yang lebih konsisten, aparat yang lebih akuntabel, dan rasa aman yang lebih dirasakan warga.
segments.tr: Its results are seen in more consistent law enforcement, more accountable officials, and a stronger sense of security felt by citizens.

segments.src: Dengan indikator yang jelas, masyarakat dapat menilai kinerja secara proporsional dan berbasis data, bukan sekadar persepsi.
segments.tr: With clear indicators, society can assess performance proportionally and based on data, rather than mere perception.

segments.tr: *This article is informative in nature and is not intended as an endorsement or evaluation of any party.*

id-20261026-international-logistics-tran.title: [International Logistics and Transportation #4] The Steel Boxes That Changed World Trade: Understanding FCL, LCL, and How Container Terminals Work

segments.src: > Peti kemas (kontainer) adalah kotak baja berukuran standar yang membuat barang bisa berpindah dari truk ke kapal lalu ke kereta tanpa dibongkar-muat satu per satu. Anda bisa menyewa satu kontainer penuh (FCL) atau berbagi kontainer dengan pengirim lain (LCL).
segments.tr: > A container (shipping container) is a standard-size steel box that lets goods move from truck to ship to train without being unloaded and loaded one by one. You can rent one full container (FCL) or share a container with other shippers (LCL).

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Sebelum ada kontainer, barang dikirim dalam karung, peti kayu, dan drum yang dimuat ke kapal satu per satu oleh buruh pelabuhan.
segments.tr: Before containers existed, goods were shipped in sacks, wooden crates, and drums that dock workers loaded onto ships one by one.

segments.src: Prosesnya lama, banyak barang rusak atau hilang, dan kapal bisa tertahan berhari-hari di pelabuhan.
segments.tr: The process was slow, many goods were damaged or lost, and ships could be held up in port for days.

segments.src: Pada pertengahan 1950-an, pengusaha angkutan asal Amerika Serikat, Malcom McLean, mempopulerkan ide sederhana: masukkan barang ke dalam kotak baja berukuran sama, lalu pindahkan **kotaknya**, bukan isinya.
segments.tr: In the mid-1950s, American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean popularized a simple idea: put goods into steel boxes of the same size, then move the **box**, not its contents.

segments.src: Kuncinya ada pada **standardisasi**.
segments.tr: The key lies in **standardization**.

segments.src: Karena ukurannya seragam (mengikuti standar ISO), kontainer yang sama bisa diangkut kapal, truk, dan kereta, juga diangkat oleh crane di pelabuhan mana pun di dunia.
segments.tr: Because the size is uniform (following ISO standards), the same container can be carried by ships, trucks, and trains, and lifted by cranes at any port in the world.

segments.src: Kapasitas kapal dan pelabuhan pun diukur dengan satuan **TEU** (*Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit*), yaitu setara satu kontainer 20 kaki.
segments.tr: Ship and port capacity is also measured in **TEU** (*Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit*), meaning the equivalent of one 20-foot container.

segments.src: **Jenis kontainer yang paling umum:**
segments.tr: **Most common container types:**

segments.src: - **Dry container 20 kaki (20' GP)**: volume dalam sekitar 33 m³. Cocok untuk barang berat tapi padat, misalnya keramik atau kopi dalam karung.
segments.tr: - **20-foot dry container (20' GP)**: internal volume of about 33 m³. Suitable for heavy but dense goods, such as ceramic tiles or coffee in sacks.

segments.src: - **Dry container 40 kaki (40' GP)**: sekitar 67 m³, dihitung sebagai 2 TEU.
segments.tr: - **40-foot dry container (40' GP)**: about 67 m³, counted as 2 TEU.

segments.src: - **40' High Cube (40' HC)**: lebih tinggi sekitar 30 cm, volumenya sekitar 76 m³. Cocok untuk barang ringan tapi makan tempat, seperti furnitur atau garmen.
segments.tr: - **40' High Cube (40' HC)**: about 30 cm taller, with a volume of about 76 m³. Suitable for light but bulky goods, such as furniture or garments.

segments.src: - **Reefer**: kontainer berpendingin untuk ikan, buah, atau obat-obatan. Suhunya diatur dan perlu colokan listrik selama di terminal dan di kapal.
segments.tr: - **Reefer**: refrigerated container for fish, fruit, or pharmaceuticals. The temperature is controlled, and it needs an electrical connection while at the terminal and on the ship.

segments.src: - **Open top & flat rack**: kontainer tanpa atap atau tanpa dinding samping, untuk muatan yang terlalu tinggi atau lebar, seperti mesin besar.
segments.tr: - **Open top & flat rack**: containers without a roof or without side walls, for cargo that is too tall or wide, such as large machinery.

segments.src: - **Tank container**: tangki dalam rangka baja untuk cairan, misalnya bahan kimia atau minyak nabati.
segments.tr: - **Tank container**: a tank inside a steel frame for liquids, for example chemicals or vegetable oil.

segments.src: **FCL vs LCL: menyewa satu kontainer atau berbagi?**
segments.tr: **FCL vs LCL: renting one container or sharing?**

segments.src: - **FCL (Full Container Load)**: satu pengirim memakai satu kontainer utuh. Kontainer diisi dan disegel di gudang pengirim, lalu baru dibuka lagi oleh penerima. Biayanya dihitung **per kontainer**, berapa pun isinya.
segments.tr: - **FCL (Full Container Load)**: one shipper uses one whole container. The container is filled and sealed at the shipper's warehouse, and only opened again by the receiver. The cost is calculated **per container**, regardless of what it holds.

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load)**: barang dari beberapa pengirim digabung (*konsolidasi*) dalam satu kontainer di gudang khusus yang disebut **CFS** (*Container Freight Station*). Di pelabuhan tujuan, kontainer dibongkar dan barang dipisahkan lagi. Biayanya biasanya dihitung **per meter kubik atau per ton**, dipilih yang lebih besar (prinsip *W/M*, weight or measurement).
segments.tr: - **LCL (Less than Container Load)**: goods from several shippers are combined (*consolidation*) in one container at a special warehouse called a **CFS** (*Container Freight Station*). At the destination port, the container is unloaded and the goods are separated again. The cost is usually calculated **per cubic meter or per ton**, whichever is greater (the *W/M* principle, weight or measurement).

segments.src: LCL cocok untuk volume kecil, tetapi ada biaya tambahan di CFS, waktu transit lebih lama karena proses gabung-bongkar, dan risiko rusak sedikit lebih tinggi karena barang lebih sering ditangani.
segments.tr: LCL suits small volumes, but there are extra charges at the CFS, transit time is longer because of the consolidation and unloading process, and the risk of damage is slightly higher because the goods are handled more often.

segments.src: Banyak praktisi menyebut FCL mulai lebih hemat ketika volume mendekati kisaran 13–15 m³, tetapi titik impasnya selalu bergantung pada tarif rute saat itu.
segments.tr: Many practitioners say FCL starts to be cheaper when volume approaches the range of 13–15 m³, but the break-even point always depends on the route rate at the time.

segments.src: **Bagaimana terminal peti kemas bekerja?**
segments.tr: **How does a container terminal work?**

segments.src: Terminal bisa dibayangkan sebagai "stasiun transit" kontainer dengan empat area utama:
segments.tr: A terminal can be pictured as a container "transit station" with four main areas:

segments.src: 1. **Dermaga (quay)**: tempat kapal bersandar. *Quay crane* atau *ship-to-shore crane* (STS) raksasa mengangkat kontainer dari dan ke kapal.
segments.tr: 1. **Quay**: where ships dock. Giant *quay cranes* or *ship-to-shore cranes* (STS) lift containers to and from the ship.

segments.src: 2. **Lapangan penumpukan (container yard)**: kontainer ditumpuk sementara sambil menunggu kapal atau truk. Alat seperti *RTG* (*Rubber-Tyred Gantry*) dan *reach stacker* memindahkan dan menyusun tumpukan.
segments.tr: 2. **Container yard**: containers are temporarily stacked while waiting for a ship or truck. Equipment such as *RTGs* (*Rubber-Tyred Gantries*) and *reach stackers* move and arrange the stacks.

segments.src: 3. **Gerbang (gate)**: titik masuk-keluar truk. Dokumen diperiksa dan kondisi kontainer dicatat di sini.
segments.tr: 3. **Gate**: the entry and exit point for trucks. Documents are checked and the container's condition is recorded here.

segments.src: 4. **Sistem operasi terminal (TOS)**: perangkat lunak yang mengatur posisi setiap kontainer, urutan bongkar-muat, dan jadwal alat.
segments.tr: 4. **Terminal Operating System (TOS)**: software that manages each container's position, the loading and unloading sequence, and equipment schedules.

segments.src: Hal yang diukur dari sebuah terminal antara lain berapa kontainer per jam yang bisa dipindahkan oleh crane, dan berapa lama kontainer menginap di lapangan (*dwelling time*).
segments.tr: What is measured at a terminal includes how many containers per hour the cranes can move, and how long containers stay in the yard (*dwelling time*).

segments.src: Makin lama kontainer menginap, makin padat lapangan dan makin mahal biaya bagi pemilik barang.
segments.tr: The longer containers stay, the more crowded the yard becomes and the more expensive it is for cargo owners.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bu Sari punya usaha mebel kayu jati di **Jepara**.
segments.tr: Ms. Sari runs a teak furniture business in **Jepara**.

segments.src: Seorang pembeli di Belanda memesan 10 set kursi teras.
segments.tr: A buyer in the Netherlands ordered 10 sets of patio chairs.

segments.src: Setelah dikemas, volumenya hanya sekitar **5 m³**.
segments.tr: After packing, the volume was only about **5 m³**.

segments.src: Menyewa satu kontainer 20 kaki penuh jelas boros, jadi forwarder menyarankan **LCL**.
segments.tr: Renting a full 20-foot container would clearly be wasteful, so the freight forwarder recommended **LCL**.

segments.src: Barang Bu Sari dibawa truk ke gudang CFS di **Semarang**, digabung dengan kiriman eksportir lain, lalu kontainernya dimuat di **Pelabuhan Tanjung Emas**.
segments.tr: Ms. Sari's goods were trucked to a CFS warehouse in **Semarang**, combined with other exporters' shipments, and the container was then loaded at **Tanjung Emas Port**.

segments.src: Ia membayar per meter kubik ditambah biaya CFS dalam rupiah.
segments.tr: She paid per cubic meter plus CFS fees in rupiah.

segments.src: Setahun kemudian pesanan naik menjadi **60 m³** per pengiriman.
segments.tr: A year later, orders rose to **60 m³** per shipment.

segments.src: Kini Bu Sari memesan satu **40' High Cube** (FCL).
segments.tr: Now Ms. Sari orders one **40' High Cube** (FCL).

segments.src: Truk membawa kontainer kosong ke bengkelnya, pekerja mengisinya langsung, lalu kontainer disegel dan dikirim ke terminal.
segments.tr: A truck brings an empty container to her workshop, workers fill it directly, then the container is sealed and sent to the terminal.

segments.src: Biayanya per kontainer, barang lebih jarang dipindah-pindah, dan waktu kirim lebih cepat karena tidak perlu menunggu konsolidasi.
segments.tr: The cost is per container, the goods are moved less often, and delivery is faster because there is no need to wait for consolidation.

segments.src: Di terminal, kontainer itu masuk lewat gate, menunggu di yard, lalu diangkat crane ke kapal pengumpan menuju pelabuhan hub, sebelum diteruskan ke Rotterdam.
segments.tr: At the terminal, the container enters through the gate, waits in the yard, then is lifted by crane onto a feeder ship bound for a hub port, before being forwarded to Rotterdam.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Kontainer berukuran standar ISO membuat barang bisa berpindah antarmoda tanpa dibongkar, dan kapasitasnya diukur dalam TEU.
segments.tr: 1. ISO-standard containers let goods move between transport modes without unloading, and their capacity is measured in TEU.

segments.src: 2. FCL berarti satu kontainer untuk satu pengirim (bayar per kontainer). LCL berarti berbagi kontainer lewat CFS (bayar per m³/ton).
segments.tr: 2. FCL means one container for one shipper (paid per container). LCL means sharing a container through a CFS (paid per m³/ton).

segments.src: 3. Terminal peti kemas terdiri dari dermaga, lapangan penumpukan, gate, dan sistem operasi. Kinerjanya dilihat dari kecepatan crane dan lama kontainer menginap.
segments.tr: 3. A container terminal consists of a quay, a container yard, a gate, and an operating system. Its performance is judged by crane speed and how long containers stay.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: satuan kapasitas yang setara satu kontainer 20 kaki.
segments.tr: - **TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: a unit of capacity equal to one 20-foot container.

segments.src: - **FCL (Full Container Load)**: satu kontainer dipakai penuh oleh satu pengirim.
segments.tr: - **FCL (Full Container Load)**: one container used entirely by a single shipper.

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load)**: barang dari beberapa pengirim digabung dalam satu kontainer.
segments.tr: - **LCL (Less than Container Load)**: goods from several shippers combined in one container.

segments.src: - **CFS (Container Freight Station)**: gudang tempat muatan LCL digabung dan dipisahkan kembali.
segments.tr: - **CFS (Container Freight Station)**: a warehouse where LCL cargo is consolidated and separated again.

segments.src: - **Dwelling time**: lama kontainer berada di pelabuhan sejak dibongkar dari kapal sampai keluar terminal.
segments.tr: - **Dwelling time**: the length of time a container stays at the port from being unloaded from the ship until it leaves the terminal.

id-20261026-news-1.title: SMRC Survey October 2026: Why 50.8% of Citizens Rate the Economy Poorly and How to Read Public Perception Surveys

segments.src: Hasil survei SMRC edisi Oktober 2026 menarik perhatian banyak orang.
segments.tr: The results of the October 2026 SMRC survey attracted a lot of attention.

segments.src: Menurut laporan survei tersebut, sekitar 50,8% responden menilai kondisi ekonomi nasional **buruk**, sementara sekitar 44% menilai situasi politik **memburuk**.
segments.tr: According to the survey report, about 50.8% of respondents rated the national economic condition as **poor**, while about 44% rated the political situation as **worsening**.

segments.src: Angka seperti ini mudah dikutip, tetapi juga mudah disalahartikan.
segments.tr: Numbers like this are easy to quote, but also easy to misinterpret.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu Anda memahami apa yang sebenarnya diukur survei persepsi, apa bedanya dengan data resmi, dan faktor apa saja yang memengaruhi suasana hati publik.
segments.tr: This article helps you understand what perception surveys actually measure, how they differ from official data, and what factors influence public mood.

segments.src: > Catatan: angka di atas merujuk pada ringkasan hasil survei yang dipublikasikan. Untuk detail seperti metode, jumlah responden, dan margin of error, rujuklah laporan resmi lembaga survei.
segments.tr: > Note: the figures above refer to the published survey result summary. For details such as methodology, number of respondents, and margin of error, please refer to the official report of the survey institution.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Sebenarnya Diukur Survei Persepsi?
segments.tr: ## What Do Perception Surveys Actually Measure?

segments.src: Survei persepsi publik tidak mengukur ekonomi secara langsung.
segments.tr: Public perception surveys do not measure the economy directly.

segments.src: Survei ini mengukur **bagaimana orang merasakan dan menilai** kondisi ekonomi.
segments.tr: They measure **how people feel and assess** the economic condition.

segments.src: Responden biasanya diminta menilai keadaan ekonomi nasional, ekonomi rumah tangga, atau situasi politik dengan pilihan jawaban seperti "baik", "sedang", dan "buruk".
segments.tr: Respondents are usually asked to rate the national economic state, household economy, or political situation with response options such as "good", "fair", and "poor".

segments.src: Jawaban itu dipengaruhi banyak hal:
segments.tr: Those answers are influenced by many things:

segments.src: - pengalaman sehari-hari, seperti harga kebutuhan pokok, penghasilan, dan peluang kerja;
segments.tr: - daily experiences, such as the prices of basic necessities, income, and job opportunities;

segments.src: - informasi dari media, media sosial, dan obrolan di lingkungan sekitar;
segments.tr: - information from media, social media, and conversations in the surrounding environment;

segments.src: - harapan dan kekhawatiran tentang masa depan;
segments.tr: - hopes and concerns about the future;

segments.src: - cara pertanyaan disusun dan urutannya dalam kuesioner.
segments.tr: - the way questions are structured and their order in the questionnaire.

segments.src: Karena itu, angka 50,8% berarti **kurang lebih separuh responden berpendapat ekonomi sedang buruk**.
segments.tr: Therefore, the figure of 50.8% means **roughly half of the respondents think the economy is currently poor**.

segments.src: Angka ini bukan ukuran resmi kinerja ekonomi.
segments.tr: This figure is not an official measure of economic performance.

segments.src: ## Persepsi vs Data Resmi: Mengapa Bisa Berbeda?
segments.tr: ## Perception vs Official Data: Why Can They Differ?

segments.src: Data resmi seperti inflasi, pertumbuhan produk domestik bruto (PDB), dan tingkat pengangguran dihitung dengan metodologi statistik baku, biasanya oleh lembaga seperti Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) dan Bank Indonesia.
segments.tr: Official data such as inflation, gross domestic product (GDP) growth, and the unemployment rate are calculated using standard statistical methodologies, usually by institutions like Statistics Indonesia (BPS) and Bank Indonesia.

segments.src: Data tersebut menggambarkan **rata-rata agregat** pada periode tertentu.
segments.tr: Such data describes **aggregate averages** over a specific period.

segments.src: Persepsi publik bekerja berbeda.
segments.tr: Public perception works differently.

segments.src: Beberapa alasan mengapa keduanya bisa tidak sejalan:
segments.tr: Some reasons why the two might not align:

segments.src: 1. **Rata-rata tidak sama dengan pengalaman individu.** Pertumbuhan ekonomi yang positif secara nasional belum tentu dirasakan merata oleh semua kelompok dan daerah.
segments.tr: 1. **Average does not equal individual experience.** Positive economic growth nationally is not necessarily felt evenly by all groups and regions.

segments.src: 2. **Inflasi rendah bukan berarti harga turun.** Inflasi yang melambat hanya berarti kenaikan harga lebih pelan. Tingkat harga yang sudah naik sebelumnya tetap terasa membebani.
segments.tr: 2. **Low inflation does not mean prices are dropping.** Slowing inflation only means price increases are slower. Price levels that have already risen previously still feel burdensome.

segments.src: 3. **Jeda waktu.** Data resmi sering menggambarkan periode yang sudah lewat, sedangkan persepsi mencerminkan perasaan saat ini.
segments.tr: 3. **Time lag.** Official data often describes past periods, whereas perception reflects current feelings.

segments.src: 4. **Pengeluaran yang tidak seimbang.** Kenaikan harga pangan, transportasi, atau biaya sekolah lebih terasa bagi rumah tangga berpenghasilan terbatas, karena porsinya besar dalam belanja mereka.
segments.tr: 4. **Unbalanced spending.** Increases in food prices, transportation, or school fees are felt more heavily by limited-income households because of their large proportion in spending.

segments.src: 5. **Ketidakpastian kerja.** Pekerjaan informal atau kontrak membuat orang lebih waspada, walaupun angka pengangguran terlihat stabil.
segments.tr: 5. **Employment uncertainty.** Informal or contract jobs make people more cautious, even if the unemployment rate looks stable.

segments.src: Jadi, persepsi dan data resmi bukan saling membantah.
segments.tr: So, perception and official data do not contradict each other.

segments.src: Keduanya adalah **dua lensa berbeda** untuk melihat satu realitas yang sama.
segments.tr: They are **two different lenses** to view the exact same reality.

segments.src: ## Faktor yang Memengaruhi Suasana Hati Publik
segments.tr: ## Factors Influencing Public Mood

segments.src: Beberapa faktor yang umumnya membentuk penilaian publik terhadap ekonomi dan politik:
segments.tr: Several factors that generally shape public assessment of the economy and politics:

segments.src: - **Harga kebutuhan sehari-hari.** Beras, minyak goreng, listrik, dan bahan bakar adalah indikator yang paling cepat dirasakan.
segments.tr: - **Prices of daily necessities.** Rice, cooking oil, electricity, and fuel are the fastest-felt indicators.

segments.src: - **Kesempatan kerja dan pendapatan.** Rasa aman terhadap pekerjaan sangat menentukan penilaian ekonomi.
segments.tr: - **Job opportunities and income.** Job security strongly determines economic assessment.

segments.src: - **Beban cicilan dan utang rumah tangga.** Suku bunga dan biaya hidup memengaruhi ruang gerak keuangan keluarga.
segments.tr: - **Installment burdens and household debt.** Interest rates and living costs affect a family's financial leeway.

segments.src: - **Arus informasi.** Berita, unggahan viral, dan diskusi daring dapat memperkuat kesan tertentu, baik positif maupun negatif.
segments.tr: - **Information flow.** News, viral posts, and online discussions can reinforce certain impressions, whether positive or negative.

segments.src: - **Dinamika politik.** Perdebatan kebijakan, perubahan kepemimpinan, dan isu-isu hangat memengaruhi rasa percaya terhadap arah negara.
segments.tr: - **Political dynamics.** Policy debates, leadership changes, and hot issues affect trust in the country's direction.

segments.src: - **Perbandingan dengan masa lalu.** Orang menilai kondisi sekarang dibandingkan setahun atau beberapa tahun sebelumnya.
segments.tr: - **Comparison with the past.** People judge current conditions compared to a year or several years ago.

segments.src: ## Tips Membaca Survei dengan Kritis
segments.tr: ## Tips for Reading Surveys Critically

segments.src: Agar tidak terjebak kesimpulan yang keliru, perhatikan hal-hal berikut:
segments.tr: To avoid falling into mistaken conclusions, pay attention to the following:

segments.src: 1. **Lihat metodologinya.** Periksa jumlah responden, cara pemilihan sampel, waktu pelaksanaan, dan margin of error.
segments.tr: 1. **Look at the methodology.** Check the number of respondents, sample selection method, execution time, and margin of error.

segments.src: 2. **Bedakan "persepsi" dan "fakta terukur".** Survei persepsi menunjukkan penilaian, bukan statistik ekonomi.
segments.tr: 2. **Distinguish "perception" from "measurable facts".** Perception surveys show evaluations, not economic statistics.

segments.src: 3. **Perhatikan tren, bukan satu angka.** Perbandingan dengan survei sebelumnya jauh lebih informatif daripada satu hasil tunggal.
segments.tr: 3. **Pay attention to trends, not a single number.** Comparisons with previous surveys are much more informative than a single isolated result.

segments.src: 4. **Cermati pilihan jawaban.** Persentase "buruk" perlu dibaca bersama persentase "sedang" dan "baik".
segments.tr: 4. **Examine the response options.** The percentage of "poor" needs to be read alongside the percentages of "fair" and "good".

segments.src: 5. **Jangan menggeneralisasi berlebihan.** Hasil nasional bisa berbeda di tiap kelompok usia, wilayah, dan tingkat pendapatan.
segments.tr: 5. **Do not overgeneralize.** National results can differ across age groups, regions, and income levels.

segments.src: 6. **Bandingkan dengan sumber lain.** Gunakan data BPS, Bank Indonesia, dan lembaga survei lain sebagai pembanding.
segments.tr: 6. **Compare with other sources.** Use data from BPS, Bank Indonesia, and other survey institutions as comparisons.

segments.src: ## Apa Artinya bagi Pembaca?
segments.tr: ## What Does This Mean for Readers?

segments.src: Angka 50,8% yang menilai ekonomi buruk menunjukkan bahwa sebagian besar warga masih merasa tertekan, terlepas dari angka-angka makro.
segments.tr: The 50.8% figure rating the economy as poor indicates that most citizens still feel pressured, regardless of macro figures.

segments.src: Bagi pembuat kebijakan, hasil seperti ini bisa menjadi sinyal untuk memperbaiki komunikasi dan menelaah kelompok mana yang paling terdampak.
segments.tr: For policymakers, results like this can be a signal to improve communication and examine which groups are most impacted.

segments.src: Bagi pembaca umum, survei ini adalah pengingat bahwa gambaran ekonomi memiliki banyak sisi: ada yang bisa diukur dengan statistik, ada pula yang hanya terlihat lewat pengalaman nyata masyarakat.
segments.tr: For general readers, this survey is a reminder that the economic picture has many sides: some can be measured with statistics, while others are only visible through the real experiences of society.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Survei SMRC Oktober 2026 memberi potret suasana hati publik: separuh responden menilai ekonomi buruk dan sekitar 44% merasa situasi politik memburuk.
segments.tr: The October 2026 SMRC survey provides a snapshot of the public mood: half of the respondents rate the economy as poor and about 44% feel the political situation is worsening.

segments.src: Angka ini berguna sebagai bahan refleksi, tetapi sebaiknya dibaca bersama data resmi, tren dari waktu ke waktu, dan metodologi survei.
segments.tr: This figure is useful as material for reflection, but should be read alongside official data, trends over time, and survey methodology.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, kita bisa memahami situasi secara lebih utuh, tanpa terburu-buru menarik kesimpulan.
segments.tr: That way, we can understand the situation more completely, without rushing to conclusions.

segments.src: *Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan tidak dimaksudkan sebagai nasihat keuangan atau dukungan terhadap pihak politik mana pun.*
segments.tr: *This article is informative and is not intended as financial advice or endorsement of any political party.*
